scientific_limitations_and_integrity: Exact two-deletion histogram and uniform-input conditional entropy only for q>=3 and received words with unequal letters at distances one and two; no extremality claim over all words. Finite checks are independent corroboration of a combinatorial proof, not exhaustive over unbounded parameters. The literature comparison leaves a risk of an unindexed equivalent nonbinary specialization. No external independent audit or validation has been performed.
title: A complete two-deletion embedding histogram for locally distinct words
